MathJax 3.2.2, combined TeX-to-SVG component.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE.txt).

Used by Org's standard HTML math export, with SVG output to avoid external
font dependencies. Only pages containing native Org/LaTeX math load it.
Documentation: https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/web/components/combined.html
